title: Guess Number Higher Or Lower
summary: A supplied guess(num) API compares num to a fixed secret integer in [1,n].

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ pick ≤ n ≤ 2147483647. Use integer arithmetic that cannot overflow when finding a midpoint.
contractDetails.output-checking: Configure guess(num) using fixture pick. Invoke guessNumber(n) without passing pick to the solution. The supplied API returns sign(pick−num).

statement: A supplied guess(num) API compares num to a fixed secret integer in [1,n]. It returns −1 if num is too high, 1 if num is too low, and 0 for a match. Implement guessNumber(n) to recover the secret using this API. The pick field in fixtures configures the API and is not passed to the learner function.

examples.explanation: The API comparisons narrow the range to 13.
There is only one possible secret.
The upper endpoint must be reachable without midpoint overflow.

constraints: 1 ≤ pick ≤ n ≤ 2147483647. Use integer arithmetic that cannot overflow when finding a midpoint.
hints: Conceptual: Each API answer rules out part of the remaining range.
Directional: Try the middle of the current possible interval.
Implementation: Compute mid = low + (high−low)//2. Move high below mid for −1 and low above mid for 1.
complexityAnalysis: O(log n) API calls and time, O(1) auxiliary space.
